summary: Notifications E-N.4: notification_preference per-event DAO + defaults-seed + REST. PostgresPrefStore (src/core/postgres/pgPrefStore.ts) implements NotificationPrefStore port from T-0169 router: getPreferences (pool-based, SET LOCAL GUC), upsert (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE), listByTenant, listByEventKind. seedDefaultPreferences inserts 5 default rows idempotently (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) for: task.assigned, approval.requested, sla.warning, sla.breach, escalation.raised. REST admin GET/PUT /api/notification-preferences behind PDP gate mgmt_object:notification_config/read+update (checkAdminGrant + loadAdminContext + genesis-owner short-circuit). Self-routes GET/PUT /api/notification-preferences/self: recipient_scope structurally locked to actor:<self> server-side; body scope rejected if role: or actor: prefix (400). appendAuditEvent notif.preference.changed on PUT. UUID guard in getPreferences. 2-iteration review cycle (R-1/R-2/R-3 blocking → fixed, R-4 nit deferred). CI: tsc 0 errors, eslint 0 errors, fitness all PASS (FF-NP1..FF-NP6), vitest 1191/1191, fitness:db 540/540.
